svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.text: vibration-isolated sensor carrier on the other end of the J3 flex: BMI088, ICM-42688-P, RM3100, ICP-20100 #1, 24LC64, heater
CUAV V6X FMUM (RC11, 07-2023) · reverse-engineered from PX4 fmu-v6x board files + Pixhawk DS-010/DS-012 · not vendor data
BM20B(0.8)-34DS-0.4V(53) mating half; same pin numbers as FMUM J3
IMU 1 on SPI3, domain 3; PS = GND selects SPI. Both SDO pins share MISO (tri-state when its CS is high). PX4 rotation YAW_180 (-R 4)
IMU 2 on SPI2, domain 2. PX4 rotation YAW_270 (-R 6)
RM3100 controller: I2C mode, SA1=SA0=0 -> 0x20. Three sense coils below
Sen-XY-f: 6.5 x 2.5 mm flat coils, X and Y at 90 deg. Sen-Z-f: 3.6 mm cube, vertical axis.
Baro 1 on I2C4, AD0 = 1 -> 0x64 (baro 2 on the FMUM uses AD0 = 0 -> 0x63)
PX4 'imu_eeprom': calibration data, MFT revision, ID (mtd.cpp)
Four 470 R (marked 4700) in parallel = 117 R across VDD_5V_IN -> 0.21 W of heating right under the IMUs.
Q1 (SOT-23, marked 3400) switches the low side from the HEATER line (PB10 on the FMUM, PWM/on-off).
low-side switch; R5 100k keeps it off while the FMU boots
All rails come over the flex: SENSORS3 (pin 6) -> BMI088,
baro 1 and EEPROM; raw VDD_5V_IN (pin 28) feeds only the heater.
No regulator on this board; I2C4 pull-ups are on the FMUM.
Every SPI signal has a ground neighbour on the flex.
Octagon ~24 mm with two half-round notches for the elastomer
isolation mount; white arrow = flight direction; M1-M4 = GND.
